content: Create a photorealistic luxury website mockup displayed on an open dark space-gray MacBook Pro, floating horizontally and supported from below by a single elegant hand against a plain soft light-gray studio background. The laptop is angled slightly in perspective, screen facing the viewer, thin black bezel with a small top notch, visible keyboard base edge and ports, premium minimal product-photography lighting with subtle shadows. On the screen show a full-width French luxury concierge landing page for {argument name="brand name" default="Maison Lumière"}: a hero photo of the Eiffel Tower viewed through a large stone archway, muted Paris skyline and greenery below, refined editorial typography. Website header: brand name at top left, and exactly 4 small uppercase navigation links at top right: “À PROPOS”, “SERVICES”, “TÉMOIGNAGES”, “CONTACT”. Centered hero copy: small line “— MAISON LUMIÈRE · PARIS —”, oversized elegant serif headline “{argument name="headline text" default="Votre temps est précieux. Nous nous occupons du reste."}”, smaller subtitle “{argument name="subtitle text" default="Conciergerie privée haut de gamme à Paris"}”, and a thin outlined button reading “{argument name="button text" default="DÉCOUVRIR NOS SERVICES"}”. Use a sophisticated beige, ivory, charcoal, and soft blue color palette, high-end fashion/luxury aesthetic, realistic reflections on the laptop glass, crisp screen details, shallow depth of field, no extra objects, no watermark.

Goal: Create an ultra-detailed cinematic product photograph of an ornate fantasy business card lying on a dark antique wooden desk, designed like a luxurious vintage ticket or guild identification card for {argument name="company name" default="泡影堂 / HOU-EI-DO TRADING CO."}.

Canvas: Horizontal 3:2 composition, close-up three-quarter view, shallow depth of field, warm amber lamplight with cool blue reflections, high realism mixed with elegant anime-fantasy design.

Main object: One large cream-and-gold business card, landscape orientation, with an asymmetrical die-cut silhouette. The left side has a rounded arched portrait window and circular medallion; the right side is a rectangular information panel with clipped corners, thin gold borders, embossed filigree, holographic sparkles, tiny bubble motifs, and delicate floral engravings. The paper should look thick, pearlescent, aged ivory, and slightly glossy, with raised metallic gold ink.

Layout: Divide the card into exactly 2 main sections: 1) left portrait section, 2) right text information section. The left section contains exactly 1 anime-style male portrait, exactly 1 large circular emblem medallion with a floral crest, and numerous translucent bubbles over a moody window background. The right section contains exactly 9 visible information blocks: 1 company header, 1 department line, 1 large personal name line, 1 job title line, 3 ID-number rows, 1 signature row, and 1 address/contact row. Add exactly 1 QR code at the lower right and exactly 1 vertical serial-number strip on the far right edge.

Portrait details: The portrait shows a refined young male aesthetic officer in dark navy and black formal attire with gold chains, brooches, floral embroidery, and a high-collared shirt. He has short tousled dark hair with blue highlights. His face may be softly obscured or unfocused to keep the identity anonymous, while the outfit and hair remain sharp. Surround him with floating soap bubbles and small pale blossoms.

Text content: Use Japanese and English typographic hierarchy similar to a premium trading-company ID card. Include the large Japanese name {argument name="person name" default="月詠 泡影"} with small romanization beneath it, the company header “泡影堂” and “HOU-EI-DO TRADING CO.”, the department line “情報企画部・美学研究課 / Information & Aesthetics Dept.”, the title “主任研究員（美学士） / Chief Aesthetic Officer”, ID rows such as “EMP. ID CODE HD-0421-7A”, “MANAGEMENT NO. MGMT-8808”, and “LICENSE NO. LIC-TRD-1912-88”, a cursive signature reading “Tsukuyomi Houei”, an address/contact block, and a vertical serial label “SERIAL NO. 600711088”. Keep the typography legible but naturally integrated into the printed card.

Desk scene: Place exactly 7 surrounding props: 1 ornate glass perfume bottle on the far left, 1 warm lantern or window-like lamp behind the card, 1 brass pocket watch on the upper right, 1 fountain pen at the lower right, 1 black lacquer tray with gold floral decoration at the lower left, 1 braided cord or tassel charm near the bottom center, and 1 small metal key or hook beside the cord. Add scattered glass bubbles on and around the desk, but do not add extra cards.

Visual style: Luxurious steampunk-Victorian fantasy, Japanese antique stationery, gold foil stamping, delicate botanical ornament, transparent bubbles, cinematic bokeh, dramatic shadows, crisp macro detail, premium collectible card photography. Use warm gold, deep navy, black lacquer, ivory paper, and subtle iridescent blue highlights.

Constraints: Generate only one card, no hands, no modern plastic badge, no watermark, no extra logos beyond the crest and QR code, no misshapen typography, maintain a realistic tabletop perspective and a carefully crafted world-building atmosphere.

Goal: Create a busy 1990s Japanese fantasy RPG magazine advertisement / game box promotional poster for {argument name="game title" default="SynClub SaGa"}, with a dramatic anime schoolgirl warrior and retro console marketing layout.

Canvas: Vertical full-page ad, 2:3 aspect ratio, aged cream paper texture, dense print design, slightly distressed ink, high saturation, black and gold borders, nostalgic 16-bit RPG era aesthetic.

Main layout: The top two-thirds is a fantasy key visual. At the very top, add a narrow Japanese tagline banner using {argument name="top tagline" default="異世界に召喚された女子高生（きなこ）の壮大な冒険が今、始まる!!"}. Beneath it on the upper left, place a huge ornate logo reading {argument name="game title" default="SynClub SaGa"}: blue-and-gold serif letters for “SynClub,” red-and-gold letters for “SaGa,” with decorative fantasy filigree and a small subtitle plaque. The background is split between a bright blue-sky castle kingdom on the left and a dark purple lightning demon castle on the right. On the right side, add vertical glowing Japanese copy using {argument name="vertical tagline" default="光と闇の狭間で、少女は運命を選ぶ―"}.

Main character: Center-right foreground, a teenage Japanese schoolgirl summoned to a fantasy world, long windblown black hair, face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur, wearing a navy sailor school uniform mixed with polished silver knight armor: armored breastplate, right shoulder pauldron, metal gauntlets, brown leather belts, gold buckles, medallion brooch, short pleated skirt, navy neckerchief, and a sheathed or lowered sword angled across the lower left. Her pose is heroic and slightly angled, hair flowing across the logo area.

Story box: On the left under the logo, place a small parchment-like story panel headed “STORY” in English followed by dense Japanese body copy, imitating a game magazine synopsis. Keep the copy small and mostly decorative but visibly Japanese.

Gameplay strip: Directly below the key visual, create exactly 4 bordered screenshot panels with numbered captions. Panel 1 shows a colorful top-down world map with forest, river, and tiny player character. Panel 2 shows an indoor dialogue/event scene with two characters and a text box. Panel 3 shows an action battle in a fiery volcanic battlefield with a bright sword beam. Panel 4 shows a final boss RPG battle against a large purple demon with status boxes and HP/MP interface. Above these panels place a bold yellow-and-red Japanese headline using {argument name="feature headline" default="美麗グラフィック＆重厚ストーリー！4つの世界が君を待つ！"}.

Bottom product section: Divide the bottom third into a left product bundle area and a right sales-copy area. Left side must show exactly 3 purchasable items: a tall game box with the same cover art, a black cartridge labeled with the game logo, and a shiny CD soundtrack disc. Also show a small black retro fictional handheld/console device underneath, clearly not a real brand. Add a red stamp-style label meaning “Now on sale,” a price block reading 7,800 yen plus tax, and a note about an original soundtrack CD bonus.

Compatibility row: Along the bottom left, include exactly 5 small hardware/media icons or badges: 1) AI computer, 2) 8-bit system, 3) CD-ROM, 4) 16-BIT, 5) iOS / android series compatible. Use fictional names and avoid any real company logos or real console designs.

Right sales-copy area: Large bold red Japanese promotional text in stacked lines, advertising a grand adventure, emotional story, a girl warrior challenging darkness, and changing the fate of the world. Under it, add smaller black explanatory Japanese copy about a 16-bit-style fantasy RPG with beautiful graphics, moving BGM, and heavy story. At the bottom right, add a fake publisher logo and company block reading “Noel Soft,” with a blue decorative emblem, fictional address, phone number, copyright line, and small credit text.

Visual style: Detailed anime illustration blended with retro Japanese magazine ad design, ornate fantasy logo typography, halftone print texture, gold trim, dramatic lighting, saturated blues, reds, purples, and yellows. The ad should feel slightly overstuffed and playful, like a parody of classic JRPG marketing.

Constraints: Use no real company names, no real console names, no real logos, and no real hardware silhouettes. Keep the main character’s face blurred/obscured. Include exactly 4 gameplay screenshot panels, exactly 3 product bundle items, and exactly 5 compatibility badges. Make the overall page text-heavy and convincingly Japanese, while preserving the fictional branding.

Goal: Create an ultra-detailed fantasy anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a teal-haired dragon knight princess"} standing inside a ruined cathedral-like atelier filled with paper models, crystal circuitry, and magical engineering relics.

Canvas: Vertical portrait composition, 4:5 aspect ratio, dense foreground-to-background detail, cinematic lighting, no border, no watermark.

Main subject: One young anime woman stands slightly right of center, facing forward with a calm serious expression. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="turquoise teal"} hair, small horn-like accessories, pale skin, and an ornate black, white, and silver gothic fantasy outfit with layered skirt panels, armor straps, ribbons, chains, and gem details. She holds one long spear or lance diagonally across her body, its shaft extending from lower center toward upper left, with delicate metallic ornaments and teal magical glow.

Creature and companion count: Include exactly 3 major companion figures: 1 enormous pale stone-and-teal dragon coiling behind and to the right of the girl, with an angular head, glowing green eyes, folded serpentine neck, and crystalline teal accents; 1 adorable teal dragon plush toy seated in the lower-left foreground, with soft rounded limbs, small horns, a large glowing turquoise gem-like eye, tiny claws, and ornate jewelry around its neck; 1 translucent turquoise holographic spirit girl on the left side behind the plush, glowing like a projected magical blueprint, with long hair and a faint dress silhouette.

Foreground objects count: Include exactly 5 prominent foreground relics: 1 large beige paper-model spaceship or airship stretching across the bottom from left to right with panel lines, teal glowing circular engine light, and emerald stained-glass sections; 1 small ornate birdcage-like golden structure at the lower left; 1 rectangular paper blueprint tag hanging near the lower right; 1 cluster of teal crystals near the plush; 1 tangled web of golden chains and filigree wires draped over the spaceship and floor.

Environment: The setting is an immense gothic cathedral workshop with tall pointed arches, carved ivory stone, miniature spires, scaffold-like paper architecture, suspended wires, blueprint sheets, fragmented parchment panels, and teal crystal growths. In the upper center background, place 1 large circular rose window glowing turquoise and white, with exactly 3 tall lancet stained-glass windows beneath it. Add additional narrow stained-glass windows at the sides, but keep the central rose window dominant.

Visual style: Highly polished Japanese fantasy illustration, ornate anime character design, intricate linework, soft painterly rendering, luminous turquoise and emerald highlights, warm beige stone and parchment tones, ethereal dust, layered depth, magical cathedral ambience, elegant steampunk-paper-craft details, extremely detailed but harmonious.

Lighting and color: Use a palette of ivory, antique parchment, silver, deep charcoal, emerald, and glowing cyan-teal. Backlight the scene through stained glass, add turquoise rim light around the dragon, hologram, crystals, plush eye, and spear ornaments. Keep the mood dreamy, mysterious, and luxurious.

Constraints: No readable text, no modern objects, no extra characters beyond the 1 main girl, 1 large dragon, 1 plush dragon, and 1 holographic spirit girl. The plush dragon should look especially cute and desirable as a stuffed toy while still matching the elaborate fantasy world.

Create a realistic candid smartphone photo of a young woman at an outdoor city event, shot from a close slightly high-angle perspective with a wide-angle lens. She is leaning playfully toward the camera, making a sideways peace sign beside her face with her right hand, while her left arm hangs down. Her face is intentionally covered by a flat opaque square censor block in a muted skin-tone color. She has a high messy ponytail with {argument name="hair color" default="pink peach hair with a small teal-blue streak"}, loose wispy strands, small earrings, rings, and glossy decorated nails. She wears a fitted dark indigo denim halter overall jumpsuit with visible seams, structured bust cups, thick straps, and a snug waist, giving an energetic street-fashion look. The background is an outdoor festival or expo entrance on asphalt, with white peaked event tents, blue crowd-control railings, scattered pedestrians slightly motion-blurred, tall modern apartment towers, cloudy daylight sky, and shallow depth of field. Use natural lighting, realistic skin texture, casual Japanese urban atmosphere, vertical 2:3 composition, candid social-media photo style, no text, no watermark.

Create a high-quality vertical anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Reina"}, a Japanese high school girl taking a close-up arm-extended selfie inside a sunlit classroom. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="dark forest green hair with pale mint-green tips"}, glossy layered strands, and one hand raised near her temple as if adjusting her hair. Her face is intentionally covered by a large centered opaque square censor block with a muted gray-to-beige color, hiding all facial features from forehead to chin. She wears a neat navy school uniform blazer with gold buttons, a crisp white shirt, and a large {argument name="bow color" default="deep red ribbon bow"} at the collar, with a pleated navy skirt partially visible. The camera angle is a dynamic wide-angle selfie perspective from slightly above and in front, with her extended left arm dominating the lower-left foreground and her torso centered. Background: a bright empty classroom with wooden desks and chairs, a green chalkboard on the left, tall windows on the right, warm morning sunlight streaming in, soft bloom, dust motes, and gentle depth of field. Style: polished modern anime key visual, detailed hair highlights, clean line art, soft painterly shading, warm cinematic lighting, vertical 3:4 composition, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.

Goal: Create a dramatic vertical Japanese mystery-novel tribute poster featuring {argument name="character name" default="Kosuke Kindaichi"} seated in the foreground, styled as a gritty Taisho/Showa-era detective illustration.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster composition, dark high-contrast cinematic lighting, red-and-black palette, aged paper and horror-mystery atmosphere. Use a full-bleed layout with no border.

Subject details: Center foreground shows an adult Japanese male detective sitting cross-legged on a tatami or wooden floor. He wears a rumpled gray kimono-style outfit, loose gray hakama-like trousers, a black haori cloak, and a soft wrinkled gray hat. His posture is slightly hunched and weary; one hand touches the brim of his hat, the other rests on the handle of an old worn brown leather travel suitcase with brass hardware. His face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur or neutral censor block, while the body, clothing, hands, hat, and suitcase remain sharp and detailed.

Background: A dim old Japanese mansion interior with sliding shoji screens, wooden lattice, faint lamps, deep shadows, and blood-red illumination. Add subtle grunge textures, scratches, smoky darkness, and a sense of old crime-scene dread. The background should be partially hidden by large typography.

Text layout: Fill the poster with exactly 6 large white Japanese mystery-title text elements, distressed and slightly red-stained, arranged around and behind the seated figure. Use oversized vertical and horizontal Mincho-style serif typography with dramatic scale differences. The 6 visible title elements are: 1) 「犬神家の一族」 across the upper left, 2) 「八つ墓村」 huge across the upper right, 3) 「獄門島」 very large across the left-center/center, 4) 「悪魔が来りて笛を吹く」 across the mid-right, 5) 「悪魔の手毬唄」 stacked vertically on the left, 6) 「本陣殺人事件」 stacked vertically on the far right. Add a small date near the bottom right reading {argument name="date text" default="May 24, 2026"} and a small cursive signature reading {argument name="signature" default="Gyagi"} beneath it.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed AI illustration with photorealistic fabric folds and suitcase texture, mixed with vintage Japanese book-cover design. Strong white typography, crimson shadows, black vignette, high contrast, ominous detective-fiction mood, nostalgic yet unsettling.

Constraints: Keep exactly one seated detective and exactly one suitcase. Keep the 6 listed Japanese titles legible and prominent. Do not add extra title names, extra characters, modern objects, logos, or watermarks.

Create a square 1:1 close-up food advertisement photo of a cheesy quesadilla, shot in warm golden light with shallow depth of field. The foreground shows two stacked triangular halves of a toasted flour tortilla quesadilla on a dark rustic plate, cut open so the filling is highly visible: browned spiced ground beef, glossy sauce, and abundant melted yellow-white cheese stretching in long strands between the top and bottom pieces and dripping over the edges. The tortilla surface should be crisp with scattered golden-brown char marks and soft blistering. Use a dark wooden table background, softly blurred, with a small out-of-focus bowl of greens and cherry tomatoes in the upper right. Overlay energetic Japanese handwritten brush typography: exactly 3 text elements, consisting of 1 small orange handwritten line at the upper left reading {argument name="top handwritten text" default="チーズたっぷり"} with a curved underline flourish, 1 large bold white brush-script headline across the upper center reading {argument name="main headline text" default="ケサディーヤ"}, and 1 smaller white handwritten note at the lower left reading {argument name="bottom handwritten text" default="とろ〜り チーズ"}. Add exactly 4 orange doodle accents: a thick orange brush underline sweeping beneath the main headline, two short orange emphasis marks near the lower left edge, three short orange rays near the upper right of the headline, and a small orange heart beside the lower-left note. Make the typography look like casual hand-painted Japanese marker lettering, slightly imperfect and organic. Keep the food hyper-realistic, appetizing, high contrast, with saturated cheese yellows, rich beef browns, and a cozy restaurant-menu feel. No people, no logos, no watermarks, no extra text.

Goal: Create a vibrant Japanese travel-video title card for a short-form prompt collection, combining a cinematic spring travel photo background with glossy neon UI graphics.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 image, 1152×768 feel, high-resolution, bright pastel color grading, soft bloom and lens flare.

Background: A young woman traveler stands on the right side at a train platform beside a modern train, viewed from behind/three-quarter back, face intentionally obscured by a plain skin-tone rectangular blur. She has long wavy dark brown hair, wears a light beige trench coat, carries a tan shoulder bag, and holds the handle of a small rolling suitcase near the bottom center. The setting is a dreamy cherry-blossom station in spring, with pink sakura trees filling the left and upper background, scattered falling petals, warm sunlight, and shallow depth of field.

Main graphic layout: Place a large rounded gradient banner across the left-center, extending toward the woman. The banner uses a blue-to-purple-to-pink translucent glossy gradient with a large circular badge on the far left. Inside the circle, display a huge white number {argument name="section number" default="4."}. To the right of the circle, set bold rounded Japanese headline text in white: {argument name="headline text" default="旅行・季節・青春シネマ"}. Below it, add a smaller white rounded pill label with purple-pink text: {argument name="subtitle text" default="情緒・旅感・短編向け"}.

Visible text count: exactly 3 text elements: 1 large number badge reading "4.", 1 main Japanese headline reading "旅行・季節・青春シネマ", and 1 subtitle pill reading "情緒・旅感・短編向け".

Neon icon overlay count: exactly 9 glowing white-pink line icons and decorative elements around the banner and right side: 1 suitcase icon at upper left, 1 cherry blossom icon near upper center-left, 1 camera icon above the banner, 1 play button icon inside a rounded rectangle on the upper right, 1 clapperboard icon on the mid-right, 1 signpost arrow icon at lower left, 1 dotted travel path sweeping along the lower left-to-center, 1 map pin near the end of the dotted path, and 2 small sparkle/star accents near the top center and right side. Keep all icons semi-transparent, neon outlined, and softly glowing.

Style: Japanese social-media thumbnail design, cute travel aesthetic, glossy gradient panels, soft pink and lavender atmosphere, cinematic bokeh, dreamy sakura petals, clean rounded typography, bright white text with subtle glow, polished promotional-card composition.

Constraints: Keep the woman on the right and the graphic title block on the left, do not add extra text, do not add logos or watermarks, keep the face covered by a simple rectangular blur, and maintain a cheerful spring travel mood.

Create a vibrant Japanese marketing course thumbnail for {argument name="campaign topic" default="CM・広告・商品訴求"}. Use a 16:9 horizontal canvas, 1184×768 style, with a glossy purple-blue neon aesthetic and soft depth-of-field office lighting. Background: a modern cosmetics marketing workspace with a blurred large monitor showing a campaign dashboard; visible English text on the monitor includes “NEW CAMPAIGN” and small chart/product panels. On the right, place a young woman marketer in a lavender blouse, seated at a desk with one hand near her chin holding a pen; her face is intentionally hidden by a large opaque matte brown rectangle. Desk details include exactly 5 main objects: an open laptop on the left, a disposable coffee cup in front, printed marketing sheets with colorful layout thumbnails, cosmetics bottles on the right, and a small sign reading “NEW ARRIVAL 30% OFF LIMITED CAMPAIGN.” Overlay a large rounded gradient banner across the lower-left to center, blue-to-purple with glow and transparency. On the far left of the banner, put a large circular badge with the white text “2.”. Main Japanese headline on the banner: “CM・広告・商品訴求” in bold white rounded sans-serif, with “商品訴求” on the second line. Beneath it, add a white pill-shaped label with blue and pink text: “商品訴求・販促・告知向け”. Add exactly 3 large neon line icons: a cyan megaphone in the upper left, a pink shopping bag below it, and a purple play button inside a rounded rectangle on the upper right. Add exactly 8 small glowing sparkle accents scattered around the composition, plus a small pink upward bar-chart icon near the bottom center. Overall style: Japanese YouTube thumbnail, polished digital advertising design, luminous gradients, cinematic blur, clean readable typography, no watermark, no extra text beyond the specified labels.

Goal: Create a highly detailed vertical anime key visual poster for a fictional magical-girl cosplay event and fantasy idol series titled {argument name="series title" default="星鍵 マジカ･トリックスター"}, with a sparkling celestial magic theme and ornate Japanese game-poster composition.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, dense full-bleed illustration, ultra colorful, high saturation, luminous fantasy lighting, no borders. Background is a cosmic pastel galaxy filled with star trails, magic circles, glowing constellations, fireworks-like sparkles, floating keys, ribbons, flowers, and prismatic light effects.

Main layout: Arrange exactly 7 anime magical-girl characters in a dramatic ensemble around a central heroine, all with softly blank/obscured faces as if anonymized, while their costumes and poses remain detailed. The central figure is largest and in front; the other six surround her in layered depth. Use ornate visual effects to create a premium Japanese fantasy mobile-game promotional illustration.

Character count and details: 1) Center heroine: a blonde bunny-ear magical girl wearing a pink-and-white frilly dress, fluffy white rabbit hood with tall ears, strawberry and carrot accessories, white puff sleeves, ribbon corset lacing, pom-pom cuffs, soft pastel skirt, holding a small carrot-like wand or charm; she is turned slightly sideways with an elegant idol-poster pose. 2) Upper left: a gothic witch magical girl with long black hair fading into hot pink curls, huge black witch hat with bat-wing shapes and pink roses, black-and-pink lace dress, corset details, dramatic dark magical aura. 3) Left middle: a monochrome gothic lolita magical girl with short black bob hair, white blouse, black vest, black layered skirt, chains, cross-like accessories, and a subdued mysterious pose. 4) Lower left: a red twin-tail devilish magical girl in a black-and-red punk outfit, heart motif on the chest, black gloves, red ribbons, small horn-like styling, holding a dark wand or weapon with red accents. 5) Upper right: an elegant ice-blue celestial sorceress with very long pale blue hair, white-and-blue dress with crystalline trim, blue jewel brooch, ornate staff topped with icy wings and crystals, calm regal pose. 6) Right middle: a blonde angel/fairy magical girl in a white pastel dress with blue, pink, and gold details, translucent rainbow wings, floral decorations, floating ribbons, gentle pose. 7) Lower right: a small blue-and-white fairy idol magical girl with pale hair, white frilly dress with blue ribbons, crescent-moon or arc-shaped blue accessory, soft magical glow, seated or floating near the title.

Title and typography: At the bottom center, place a large ornate Japanese logo reading {argument name="Japanese logo text" default="星鍵 マジカ･トリックスター"}. Use gold, violet, and white gradients, thick decorative outlines, starbursts, curls, and gem-like highlights. Below it, add the English subtitle {argument name="English subtitle" default="Star-Key Magica Trickster"} in a smaller elegant serif style. Include decorative golden keys, stars, crescent flourishes, and a compass/star emblem integrated into the logo.

Visual style: Premium anime fantasy illustration, intricate lace and fabric rendering, glossy magical-girl costume design, layered character silhouettes, sparkly bokeh, glowing particles, pastel pink/blue/purple palette with black/red accents, high-detail hair strands, jewel highlights, ornate staff and accessory design, energetic but balanced composition.

Constraints: Use exactly 7 characters and exactly the two title lines specified. Keep all faces intentionally blank or softly obscured, without facial features. Do not add extra readable text, watermarks, signatures, or logos beyond the title and subtitle. Preserve the dense celebratory poster look for a fictional {argument name="event name" default="AI Cosplay Expo 2026"}.

Goal: Create a glossy YouTube thumbnail-style image for an ASMR streamer niche, combining a realistic cozy creator photo with large Japanese title graphics and neon social-media icons.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 thumbnail, 1152×768 style composition, cinematic shallow depth of field, cool blue and purple lighting with soft pink highlights.

Main subject: A young female ASMR YouTuber sits on the right half of the frame in a cozy bedroom or streaming room, wearing an off-shoulder lavender knit sweater and black in-ear monitors. Her face is intentionally covered by a large flat rectangular privacy block in muted brown, centered over the face from forehead to chin. She holds a large black condenser microphone with silver mesh grille close to her mouth, mounted in a black shock mount on a stand. Her visible hands have neat pale nails. The mood is intimate, calm, and whisper-stream themed.

Background: Soft-focus bedroom/studio with curtains, shelves, small plants, fairy lights, and a bed or sofa. Use blue-purple ambient lighting throughout, with pink bokeh lights in the center background. Add a glowing mushroom-shaped table lamp at the bottom right and white-and-lavender headphones partially visible beside it.

Layout: Put the creator and microphone on the right, and place a large translucent rounded rectangle title panel across the lower-left to center-left. The panel has a blue-to-purple gradient glassmorphism look. On the far left of the panel, include one large circular gradient badge containing the number “1.” in bold white. To the right of the badge, place the main headline in bold rounded white lettering: “ASMR・配信・” on the first line and “YouTuber” on the second line. Beneath it, add a smaller white pill-shaped label containing “ささやき・会話・配信向け” in blue-to-pink text.

Visible text: Use exactly 3 text blocks: 1) “1.” inside the circle badge, 2) main headline “{argument name="headline text" default="ASMR・配信・YouTuber"}”, 3) subtitle “{argument name="subtitle text" default="ささやき・会話・配信向け"}”. Keep all text crisp, readable, and faithful to the Japanese characters.

Decorative elements: Include exactly 7 neon/social graphic elements around the scene: 1) glowing cloud outline in the upper left, 2) white neon microphone icon below the cloud, 3) white neon chat bubble with three dots beside it, 4) glowing play-button outline in the upper right, 5) audio waveform line along the lower left, 6) one white music-note icon near the bottom center, 7) multiple small sparkle stars scattered near the icons and right edge as a single sparkle cluster style. Use purple, white, and pink neon glow.

Visual style: Realistic photo base with overlaid clean vector graphics, modern creator-economy thumbnail design, soft bloom, high contrast, glossy gradients, rounded typography, dreamy ASMR atmosphere, no watermark, no extra logos, no extra text. Use {argument name="main color palette" default="lavender, blue, purple, and soft pink"} lighting and emphasize {argument name="content niche" default="ASMR streaming and YouTuber prompts"}.

Create a dreamy photorealistic fantasy portrait in a sunlit park beside a small pond, showing a young woman in sweet pink lolita fashion kneeling next to her tiny summoned familiar, a cherry blossom fairy named {argument name="fairy name" default="*リリィ*"}. The woman has a deliberately obscured/featureless rectangular face area, short pastel pink-blonde bob hair with a pink ribbon bow, white gloves, a pale pink blouse with lace collar and large bow, a pink tweed pinafore dress, white lace socks, pink Mary Jane shoes, a small name badge, and a black rosary-like cross necklace; she holds up a peace sign with her right hand while crouching warmly toward the fairy. The fairy is a small doll-like sakura spirit with pale skin, huge glossy eyes, short fluffy pink hair, translucent insect wings, bare feet, and a dress made from many pink cherry blossoms; she sits near the base of a tree root with one hand raised, surrounded by glowing sparkles and scattered petals. Set the scene in a soft-focus green park with tall trees, dappled afternoon sunlight, a bench and water in the background, shallow depth of field, pastel color grading, bokeh, magical particles, and clusters of cherry blossoms in the foreground. Add handwritten pale pink Japanese text in the upper left: title {argument name="title text" default="＊リリィ＊"}, followed by a short description reading {argument name="description text" default="桜の精霊
春の訪れを告げる存在。
感情に寄り添い、
心をふわりと軽くする。
花びらの魔法で
傷ついた心を癒す。"}. Include a small doodled bow icon near the text. Keep the composition vertical 4:5, whimsical, tender, high detail, realistic photography blended with fantasy doll aesthetics, no extra characters, no watermark.

Goal: Create a screenshot-style image of a video editing/compositing workspace demonstrating chroma-key preparation for transparency.
